In this recording the first earthquake test has bound 13 and result 10, so the first scanned tile is skipped; the saved comparison does not establish a screen difference or that this first tile becomes a pit.

For shop damage it calls shk.c::add_damage(), also void and represented by existing named gaps. Preserve these only on their source branches.
